title: Read Confirmations and Their Answers
description: Read the questions you have raised and how the user answered them. Use this to find out what the user decided before continuing with the work a question was about. This only reads: it cannot answer a question, and nothing about it changes what you are allowed to do. Only the user decides.

approval_id.description: Return this one confirmation instead of a list.

status.description: Which confirmations to return. Defaults to 'pending'.

limit.description: Maximum number to return. Defaults to 20, capped at 100.
